Here are the FAQs:
{"faqs":[{"question":"What is microneedling?","answer":"Fine needles create micro-channels that prompt new collagen."},{"question":"Does microneedling hurt?","answer":"Numbing cream is applied first, so most clients feel light pressure."},{"question":"What is the downtime?","answer":"Expect one to three days of redness, similar to mild sunburn."},{"question":"How many sessions will I need?","answer":"Most clients book three to four sessions about a month apart."}]}
